answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted peer attestation with costly identity proof. A new agent must pass a live challenge and gather attestations from established, non-kin peers before it can mint rewards. Fake farms fail because each head burns compute for admission and needs independent countersignatures that a single operator cannot cheaply fake. A weak signal from cloned accounts dies as a short ripple; durable standing grows only when diverse peers confirm work over time, like juniper roots holding soil against erosion.
